note: The plan says captions only on every row and stay on her face for the risk beat, and Kalindi finds animation in the middle inauthentic. Use these only if the cut needs more.

mg.title: Paris tag
mg.src: Aida, FX6_LVH_6355 [00:23] “Les Guerriers de la Paix in Paris”
mg.use: As she says “Paris”, after the name super is gone at 00:08. Small, near the top.

mg.title: Peace, justice, dignity

text.main: work together towards peace, justice, and dignity

mg.use: Top band at the end of the row, as she says it. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Agree on everything

text.main: you do not need to agree on everything to work together

mg.use: Over Aida as she says it, before the cut to the cards B-roll.

mg.title: Brackets on the card
mg.use: Frames the middle card in the B-roll FX6_LVH_6375. Move it to where the card sits.

mg.title: The more we are divided

text.main: the more we are divided, the less we have power to put pressure on the decision-makers

mg.use: Full-frame cutaway in place of the optional EU flags B-roll. Use one, not both.

mg.title: A dignified life

text.main: human beings who just want a dignified life

mg.use: Put it on when you are back on Aida for “dignified life”.

mg.title: Immense risk

text.main: they are taking immense risk appearing together, talking to each other

mg.use: Top band only, over her face as she says it. No B-roll and no card on this beat.

mg.title: Not about liking

text.main: It's not about liking each other.

mg.use: Over Aida on the hard cut in, as she says it. Keep her hands in frame.

mg.title: Honor this effort

text.main: And they need decision makers to honor this effort.

mg.use: Full-frame cutaway while she says it, then back to her face for the last line.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: Search for Common Ground lockup + sfcg.org. Nothing under it.
mg.src: SFCG's 2024 horizontal logo, white text (SFCG Resources/Logos on Drive). The Imagine If end card is still coming from SFCG (Chase Moore). Source date: 11 Feb 2026.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it at 01:17 after the last line and hold it to the end.
